text:
Anna (PM): Quick sync  we need a single-page cutover checklist customers can sign before we start Private deploy cutovers (customer-managed networking). Keep it short, actionable, and call out what we won't fix.

Raj (Eng): Agree. From eng: rolling, non-destructive agent upgrades; a documented, timeboxed rollback; signed airgap bundle; clear preflight exit codes.

Marta (Field): Field demand: explicit customer responsibilities column + an approval line for the network owner. Customers want clarity on who changes BGP/DNS.

Kyle (NetOps): NetOps: require a BGP handoff dry-run that proves egress IP continuity, AS path sanity, and that the installer produces an egress->node mapping JSON we can verify.

Jia (SRE): Observability: minimal metric set (upgrade_progress, agent_version, node_egress_ips, upgrade_errors) + an event timeline. Telemetry toggle must respect customer KMS and be reversible.

Ben (Solutions): Add a scheduling template: suggested 2-hour maintenance window, DNS TTL recommendation 60s (or 300s if customer policy), and a fallthrough comms plan for customers and their clients.

Anna (PM): Draft one-pager bullets (minimal words):
- Preflight: network reachability, required ports, disk + kernel checks, NAT/iptables scan, egress mapping verified
- Dry-run: simulate BGP handoff & verify no egress-ip drift (NetOps sign-off required)
- Upgrade: canary (configurable 5-10%) -> roll; rolling agents, non-destructive
- Rollback: documented, timeboxed (target <45m) to restore prior agent + ip mapping; rollback script + checklist
- Packaging: online installer + airgap tarball (sha256-signed); artifact integrity required
- Observability: minimal metrics + event log; telemetry opt-out; KMS-aware keying
- Support: contracted cutover assistance; P1 triage SLA during agreed window
- Customer must: assign network owner, provide ASN/IP allocations, approve dry-run, open firewall windows, schedule DNS cutover slot
- Exclusions: misconfigured customer BGP, faulty hardware, unsupported kernel modules, third-party NAT boxes

Marta (Field): Add a short FAQ line: "If DNS TTLs are long, expect up to X minutes of dual-path traffic; we recommend lowering to 60s where possible." Also include a signoff snippet: "Network owner: name/email/signature/date".

Kyle (NetOps): I'll supply the dry-run commands (bgp neighbor show, traceroute from probes, curl --interface egress-ip) and the egress verifier. NetOps sign-off added as required gate.

Raj (Eng): I'll produce preflight tooling that returns machine-readable exit codes and human-friendly remediation. Also the rollback script and a minimal test harness to validate IP mapping. ETA Tue EOD.

Jia (SRE): I'll produce the metrics spec + 1-page troubleshooting playbook (top 4 failure modes) and a telemetry sanitization checklist. ETA Wed AM.

Ben (Solutions): I'll make the 2-column customer-facing PDF: left=what we do, right=what you do + signoff line. ETA Wed noon.

Anna (PM): GA gating proposal: require two customer-verified cutovers on distinct topologies (one on-prem BGP, one VPC/cloud) with rollback exercised. Each needs NetOps + Eng + Field signoff post-cutover.

Marta (Field): Strong yes. Field wants at least two live validations before GA comms.

Raj (Eng): Agreed. Define success: canary->full upgrade, rollback executed without IP drift, metrics nominal for 48h, and signed post-cutover report.

Kyle (NetOps): Also require at least one cutover to be performed under constrained-control-plane (airgap-like) conditions.

Anna (PM): Good. Owners recap: Raj = preflight + rollback; Kyle = dry-run + egress verifier; Jia = metrics + runbook; Ben = customer one-pager; Marta = customer responsibilities + FAQ. Ill collate and share draft for signoff Thu morning.

deploy-bot: Document uploaded: /docs/private-deploy/one-pager-cutover-signoff.md (internal)

Marta (Field): Noted  will review the draft and add two FAQ items from recent deals. :eyes:
